data.one_liner: Lightweight web server framework inspired by Shelf, with typed APIs and a high‑performance native Zig adapter.
data.what_it_does: Relic provides a robust HTTP server with routing, middleware, WebSocket support, static file handling, and a native adapter that boosts throughput. It offers typed request headers, unified body encoding, and a trie‑based router for speed.
use_when: Building scalable APIs or backend services in Dart
Migrating from Shelf to a typed, high‑performance server
Needing WebSocket or static file support out of the box
Requiring native performance boosts via relic_native
avoid_when: You only need a simple client‑side HTTP library
Your project targets very old Dart versions (<3.10)
You need a full framework with ORM or database integration
strengths: Built‑in WebSocket and static file support
data.setup_notes: Add relic to pubspec, import relic/relic.dart, create RelicApp, define routes, call app.serve() or app.serveNative()

alternatives.name: shelf
alternatives.why_pick_it: Same API style, widely used, no native Zig adapter
